summary.headline: Q4 FY26 revenue INR122 crore (up 33% QoQ), EBITDA INR98 crore, PAT INR61 crore; FY26 PAT INR316 crore vs FY25 INR598 crore, with no FY27 guidance until Q1.
summary.overview: Management described FY26 as a transition year marked by West Asia-related cost pressures and a high FY25 base. Q4 FY26 revenue was INR122 crore, up 33% sequentially, with EBITDA of INR98 crore (about 80.7% margin) and PAT of INR61 crore. FY26 revenue was INR539 crore and PAT INR316 crore, and the Board recommended a dividend of INR1.5 per share (15%). Million Minds Phase 1 was inaugurated on May 17, 2026, with about 60-65% of leasable area leased or in final stages as LOIs, and Malabar Retreat is about 79% complete. FY27 guidance on revenue and EBITDA was deferred to the Q1 FY27 results.

financial_highlights.change: lower than FY25 (not quantified on call)
vs INR598 crore in FY25 per analyst; FY24 INR461 crore
vs 50% in FY25 per analyst question and 110% in 2024 per analyst

financial_highlights.value: About INR150 crore LRD-based loan taken in March 2026; short-term borrowings INR149 crore (mainly unsecured group-entity loans)

segments.name: Million Minds Tech City (commercial)
segments.commentary: Phase 1 leasable area about 0.85 million sq ft, inaugurated May 17, 2026; 60-65% leased or in final stages (LOIs, lease agreements to be signed after BU). Annual lease revenue target from Phase 1 is INR72 crore, now guided at INR75-77 crore on full-year basis, with partial rentals from Q2/Q3 FY27.

segments.name: Malabar Retreat (residential)
segments.commentary: About 79% complete; overall project value about INR450 crore with bookings and sales commitments about INR175 crore. Completion targeted by end FY27; revenue cannot be recognised until completion, so nothing recognised to date.

segments.name: Godhavi / Smile City (land monetisation)
segments.commentary: About 46 acres monetised at an average of about INR14.1 crore per acre; about 411 acres remain. Management said further land deals are expected in FY27.

segments.name: One 91 Thaltej
segments.commentary: Sale value about INR2,100 crore against cost including land about INR1,500 crore; most land already paid. Design and approval at an advanced stage; details promised in Q1 FY27.

guidance_outlook: No FY27 revenue or EBITDA guidance; management said it will be given with Q1 FY27 results (about a month or two away).
Million Minds Phase 1 annual lease rental expected at about INR75 crore from April 1, 2027; FY27 is a partial year, with rentals starting from Q2 end or Q3 FY27 (October onwards).
Malabar Retreat completion and handover targeted by end FY27; full recognition of INR450 crore GDV expected only after completion.
Two new launches planned in FY27: Million Minds Phase 2 commercial around Q2 and a residential project around Q3; Million Minds Phase 2 construction to take about 3 years.
Management cited a free cash flow estimate of INR9,950 crore from planned projects on a conservative basis at current prevailing rates; no timeline or detailed assumptions provided.
capex_capacity: Million Minds Tech City spans about 65 acres with long-term potential of over 18 million sq ft across commercial, residential, hospitality, retail and social infrastructure.
Million Minds Phase 1 construction completion certificate received; BU (building use) permission pending and expected imminently; fit-outs in progress.
Approximately 518 acres of fully paid land reserves across Ahmedabad corridors; about 7 acres acquired in Q4 FY26; further acquisitions under negotiation (undisclosed locations).
Funding: Million Minds built from internal accruals; One 91 Thaltej construction to be funded from internal accruals; management indicated some debt may be taken in FY27.
Million Minds residential Phase 1 cost and timing to be disclosed in about two quarters.
demand_pricing: Management said Ahmedabad residential launches were about 6,745 units in Q1 2026 per Cushman & Wakefield, up 29% YoY (cited as industry data).
Company positions its projects as premium; Godhavi land sold at about INR14.1 crore per acre average.
Malabar Retreat bookings of about INR175 crore against INR450 crore project value; management expects traction to rise as completion nears.
Management said Million Minds leasing inquiries rose sharply after the May 17 inauguration; large occupiers are expected to commit after BU is received.

qa_highlights.question: Will guidance be given for FY27 revenue and EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said FY27 guidance will be given at Q1 FY27 results; it stated annual guidance is normally given at the start of the year.

qa_highlights.question: Expected annual annuity income from Million Minds Phase 1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said annual lease revenue is expected to exceed the earlier INR72 crore target, reaching about INR75-77 crore, with partial rentals in FY27 and full-year from FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Thaltej One and Smile City launch delayed for multiple quarters?
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited changing project configuration, market developments and past unsold launches; said Thaltej One details will come in Q1 FY27 and that Godhavi land sales are counted as project sales.

qa_highlights.question: Why did LOI percentage at Million Minds rise only from about 60% to 66%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said earlier figures were inquiries while the current figures are LOIs or near-final; large tenants are waiting for BU before committing, which is expected imminently.

qa_highlights.question: Why was dividend reduced to 15%?
qa_highlights.answer: Board chose lower payout to conserve cash for growth opportunities in Ahmedabad; management expects dividend to rise if cash position and projects progress.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company spin off Million Minds into a REIT?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said a REIT or monetisation option will be evaluated after full lease-up, possibly within one to two years, but no decision has been taken.

risks_watch: Repeated deferral of launch and FY27 guidance (Thaltej One, Smile City) creates execution and visibility risk; analysts flagged market share concerns versus peers.
Million Minds Phase 1 leasing is at LOI stage for 60-65% of area; conversion depends on BU receipt and on large tenants committing.
Earnings are heavily reliant on land monetisation; FY26 PAT of INR316 crore is about 47% lower than FY25 per analyst figures.
Rising input and construction costs cited due to West Asia crisis; project delays acknowledged.
Borrowings up with INR150 crore LRD loan and INR149 crore short-term unsecured group-entity loans; management says it will add LRD and presales disclosure from Q3 FY27.
Analyst-cited dividend payout cut from 110% (2024) to 15% (FY26).
summary.management_tone: Confident on long-term Ahmedabad and Million Minds prospects, but evasive on near-term numbers: repeatedly deferred FY27 guidance and launch details to Q1 FY27 and gave few quantified answers on pre-sales or launch timing.
key_quotes: So rather than give a number, which, of course, I'm going to give a guidance, as I told in Q1 FY27, that is a month or 2 from now, I would say that these 3 sources of income are going to be leading towards the revenues that we are projecting.
We have taken about INR 150 crores about loan from -- on based on our leases, which were there LOIs, which were signed.
So we will be able to exactly tell you, as I told you in my speech, as to very be specific on that in Q1 for sure.

growth.why: No FY27 revenue or EBITDA guidance until Q1 FY27 results; Million Minds Phase 1 (~0.85 mn sq ft, 60-65% leased or in LOI stage) and Malabar Retreat (79% complete, handover by FY27 end) give partial backing, while FY26 revenue fell to INR539 crore and PAT to INR316 crore from INR598 crore in FY25.
